description:
A VPN based on OpenVPN and operated by activists and hacktivists in defence of net neutrality, privacy and against censorship.



- [fix] [linux] Fix elevated startup on distros without systemctl (e.g. Devuan/sysvinit)
- [fix] [all] Emit disable-dco in generated OpenVPN config when startup options are incompatible with data channel offload
- [fix] [windows] Harden elevated named pipe against pipe-name squatting (FIRST_PIPE_INSTANCE, single instance)
- [change] [all] Misc fixes and general cleanup
